resumeText: Wei Liu is a Senior Computer Vision Engineer at Aurora Vision Systems with six years of experience. He designs deep learning models for detection, segmentation, and classification in PyTorch and TensorFlow, and builds OpenCV-based preprocessing pipelines for real-world imagery. He tunes training and inference for production and serves models as Docker containers. Previously at Sightline Robotics he shipped vision systems for industrial robotics. His focus is robust, deployable computer vision.
